tasks.title: TOTP, encrypted seeds, recovery codes and key parsing have independently checked primitives
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, new pure crypto and key modules; Required behavior: TOTP, Seed encryption (key reader and envelope), Recovery codes (generation, normalisation and digest); Acceptance evidence 4 and unit portions of 8-9; Counterexamples: TOTP window/input, recovery input, key format and envelope. Inject randomness and clock; use node:crypto without a new package. Store/replay transactions follow in T2 and HTTP use follows in T3. Record the existing bun run test duration before implementation for the final PR comparison. Each task leaves the existing full suite green.

acceptance.command: bun test src/totp.test.ts src/secret-box.test.ts src/secret-key.test.ts src/recovery-codes.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail in selected tests; focused coverage may exit nonzero. RFC 6238 Appendix B SHA-1 seed 12345678901234567890 yields six-digit values 287082, 081804, 050471, 005924, 279037, 353130 at the six specified times; base32 is GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQGEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQ. Window is c-1 through c+1, lowest matching step greater than last_step; boundaries 29999/30000 ms differ. Envelope is v1 with 12-byte nonce, 20-byte encrypted seed and 16-byte tag; wrong key, tampering, wrong user and malformed envelopes return typed failure. Ten distinct recovery codes have eight groups of four lowercase hex digits and independent node:crypto SHA-256 digests; collisions redraw. Strict key reader accepts 64 lowercase hex characters with at most one trailing LF and rejects the spec's invalid formats and admin-token equality with the literal errors.

exit 0; lint, typecheck and full tests pass with at least 80% line coverage. New pure modules follow injected-dependency and typed-failure conventions; package pins and tooling thresholds stay unchanged.

Map Acceptance evidence 1 policy cases, 2 database migration assertions, 3/5 atomic replay and reopened storage cases, 6 session storage isolation, and Counterexamples replay/partial expiry. Keep migration 1 unchanged; migrate new files through 1 then 2. Adapt existing session callers/fixtures as needed so the pre-integration server and full suite remain green; change the startup newer-schema fixture from version 2 to version 3 and the supported-version error suffix to (2). main.ts wires expiry of sessions and pending rows at start. HTTP stage enforcement and upgrade HTTP assertions are T3. Use injected time and independent/literal storage fixtures; F1-F3 apply if fixtures post factors.

acceptance.command: bun test src/two-factor-policy.test.ts src/database.test.ts src/account-store.test.ts src/factor-store.test.ts src/main.startup.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail in selected tests; the focused coverage threshold may exit nonzero. Owner requires a factor; signInStage returns full/enrol/factor/factor for acceptance 1's four literal cases. New files and a literal #562 schema-1 fixture migrate to user_version 2; saved instance/user fields are byte-equal, legacy session count is 0. Partial sessions and pending rows are live at t+899999 and expired at t+900000; full sessions retain 2592000000 ms idle expiry and 60000 ms touch. Newer schema 3 is refused with the error suffix (2). Factor/session transactions roll back on missing/consumed/expired factor session, conditional last_step failure or used digest; repeated/reopened/concurrent uses have exactly one winner. Confirmation replaces authenticator and ten hashes, deletes pending/all old sessions and creates one full session atomically; deleting user sessions cascades pending rows and leaves another user's sessions intact.

tasks.title: Owners enrol an authenticator and complete a replay-safe second factor before protected access
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, authentication integration; Required behavior: Session stages and access gate (home, factor and authenticator routes; T4 completes account overview/code-renewal/session routes), Setup step, Password sign-in, TOTP, Seed encryption, Recovery codes at enrolment/sign-in, Enrolment and replacement, Second factor at sign-in, HTTP rules and Intended disclosures for these routes. Move shared context/response/form helpers to http-context.ts; preserve raw-path matching and enforce declared access after phase/Host before Origin/body; a full session whose required authenticator is missing is effectively enrol. Integrate optional startup key, literal warning/hasSecretKey, strict start failures and 900-second partial cookies without extending partial sessions. Enrolment and full-session replacement stay together, including password recheck, ten codes, revocation and new full session. Reuse the existing password limiter and add the independent account/client factor limiter without changing auth-throttle.ts; only the factor account key clears on success. Implement metrics/logs, escaped responsive forms, no-store/CSP and update existing HTTP fixtures and docs. Acceptance evidence 1 (setup/home/policy; T4 completes all protected account routes), 2-4, 5 (creation/storage/sign-in/single use; T4 does renewal), 7-10 for these flows, and applicable Counterexamples including the new client-key and lock-boundary cases. Enforce fixture rules F1-F3: isolate non-lock cases to at most 4 failures per server and assert no 429, obtain fresh password sessions after partial expiry without resetting factor state, and compute codes for the injected POST time. Server codes come from an independent node:crypto helper checked against RFC vectors, never src/totp.ts. At an expired enrol session the gate gives 303 before pending-state checks; the 409 pending-expiry case uses a live full replacement session.

acceptance.command: bun test src/server.factor.test.ts src/server.recovery.test.ts src/server.upgrade.test.ts src/server.setup.test.ts src/server.sign-in.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail in selected tests; the focused coverage threshold may exit nonzero. Finish setup and owner password without authenticator redirect 303 to /account/authenticator; home stays gated until confirmation returns 200 with exactly 10 distinct codes. An enrolled password redirects 303 to /sign-in/factor; successful TOTP/recovery rotates cookie and CSRF and redirects to safe next_path. Reused factors from fresh password-authenticated factor sessions give 401 after reopen; two distinct factor sessions posting one fresh TOTP concurrently give exactly one 303 and one 401. Time rollback and c±2 fail, c±1 succeeds. Acceptance 3 bullets use separate databases/servers with at most 2 failures each and no 429 (F1); codes use the injected time and a step above last_step except replay cases (F3). Invalid/both/no fields give 422 without failures. Acceptance 7 uses one server: 4 wrong codes at t0, a new password at t1=t0+60000, the 5th failure at t5=t1+1000, then correct factor 429 with Retry-After 900. At t5+899999 obtain fresh password session S3, then correct current code gives 429 with Retry-After 1; at t5+900000 obtain fresh S4 then current code gives 303 (F2/F3), preserving throttle state between sessions. A separate case of 5 recovery failures locks TOTP; the mixed 3 TOTP/2 recovery case locks the 6th attempt. Another new-server case proves 3 failures, success, new password, 2 failures still locks the client key. Replacement needs password, leaves the old factor live until confirmation, then revokes old sessions/codes. For live full replacement, pending expiry is 200 at t+899999 and 409 at t+900000; expired enrol confirmation instead redirects 303 to /sign-in?next=%2Faccount%2Fauthenticator. Upgrade closes /setup with 404, rejects the old cookie with 303 to /sign-in?next=%2F and requires enrolment after password.

acceptance.command: bun test src/settings.test.ts src/cookies.test.ts src/main.startup.test.ts src/server.test.ts src/server.security.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail in selected tests; the focused coverage threshold may exit nonzero. Key errors are the literal spec texts in start order; malformed key exits 2, missing setting gives the literal warning and hasSecretKey false, valid key logs true with no bytes. Partial cookies have Max-Age=900 and requests never extend their rows/cookies; t+899999 is live and t+900000 anonymous. New routes enforce exact raw-path/404/405/phase/Host/access/Origin/415/413/400/CSRF order; gate refusals read no body or mutate rows. Wrong factor is 401, missing TOTP/enrolment key 503, unreadable seed 500 with The authenticator secret cannot be read. Sign in with a recovery code. Decryption failure releases the reservation and preserves ciphertext; recovery sign-in still gives 303 without a key or with a wrong key. Envelope matches ^v1:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{27}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$. Acceptance 8/10 file, sidecar, response/log/metrics scans have zero forbidden sentinel matches, excluding only intended disclosure responses and using owner email as a positive control. All factor fixtures follow F1-F3; non-lock failures never return 429.

exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full tests meet 80% line coverage after mandatory staged-auth integration and all existing fixtures are updated. Shared helpers and handlers respect complexity limits, raw-path matching and unchanged CSP.
